subject.title: fix: protect SMS webhook callback quota [AI]

question: Should SMS accounts with `dangerouslyDisableSignatureValidation` retain the existing 30-per-minute webhook cap, or intentionally move to the new 300-per-minute request budget?
rationale: The patch changes the protection level of an existing dangerous configuration mode, and tests plus documentation cannot determine whether that weaker boundary is intended product policy.

options.title: Preserve 30/min
options.body: Apply the existing 30-per-minute cap when validation is disabled while retaining separate invalid and signed quotas for normal accounts.

options.title: Approve 300/min
options.body: Accept the tenfold disabled-mode cap increase with explicit upgrade and security rationale plus exact-head runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve 30/min
recommendation.body: Apply the existing 30-per-minute cap when validation is disabled while retaining separate invalid and signed quotas for normal accounts.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history ties this decision to the cross-channel webhook security hardening and plugin SDK boundary work.
